body:
**All phases implemented + browser-verified in #2403** (pure model).

| Phase | What | Status |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | Setup: 6 facets → read-only summary + "Design in Studio →" deep-link (kills `[Object]`/JSON) | ✅ |
| P1b | Setup: user-assignment panel on the record page | ✅ |
| P2 | Studio: System Capabilities editor (`sys_capability` multi-select) | ✅ |
| P3 | Studio: structured RLS / tab-visibility / admin-scope editors | ✅ |
| P4 | Assignment moved out of the design editor → Setup only; no residual JSON | ✅ |

Verified live (app-showcase): `sales_rep` facet summaries + deep-link; `organization_admin` 18 RLS policies as structured rows; `showcase_field_ops_delegate` admin-scope form; capability + admin-scope save round-trips persist.

**Framework follow-up (open Q + new):** env-scope metadata saves of these facets don't project onto the queryable `sys_permission_set` data record the Setup summary reads, so a fresh Studio edit isn't reflected in Setup until the projection refreshes (enforcement reads the authoritative metadata). This is the one remaining gap for full closed-loop coherence.

**Shipped + follow-ups filed:**
- Implementation merged: #2403 ✅
- ADR-0056 revised to the pure model (Accepted): #2399 (updated; docs — ready to merge)
- The metadata↔data-record projection-freshness gap (Studio edits not reflected in Setup's read-only summary until the projection refreshes) is filed framework-side: **objectstack-ai/framework#2857**.

The objectui UI work for the pure model is complete; the one remaining gap for full closed-loop coherence is the framework projection (#2857).

Framework projection fix is up: **objectstack-ai/framework#2867** (closes framework#2857). Projects env-scope permission-set edits onto the queryable `sys_permission_set` record via the protocol's `onMetadataMutation` hook — closing the last gap so a Studio edit reflects in Setup's read-only summary. 21 unit tests + no regression; live E2E to be confirmed by framework CI (local isolated-backend repro was blocked by a worktree/pnpm resolution artifact).

## Follow-ups surfaced during go-live UAT (post-merge)

With the pure model shipped and browser-verified end-to-end (Setup read-only + Studio designs all facets), two durable follow-ups came out of the walkthrough:

- **objectstack-ai/objectui#2413** — CEL authoring safety for RLS policies (lint · field autocomplete · test-run). The Studio RLS editor renders 17 hand-typed `USING`/`CHECK` predicates with no validation; RLS is security-critical and some paths fail *open*.
- **objectstack-ai/framework#2875** — make the `sys_permission_set` data record a **pure projection**. The #2867 metadata→data-record projection was a sync band-aid; the durable fix is a single source of truth so no write path can desync the two stores.

Both are non-blocking; the shipped model works. Filing here so they're tracked against this epic.
